lines.speaker: A
lines.text: All quiet on your end?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can't complain. Village is still standing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, {other}? All good with you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So-so, {other}. Lot to do today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ah, {other}! Haven't seen you in ages.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Been busy, {other}. You know how it is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Say, {other}, did you hear that too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hear what? Out with it!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ah, forget it. Probably just the wind.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fine day today, isn't it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Aye, perfect for the fields.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what I said. Out we go.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning, {other}. Sleep well?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Like a stone. And you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Getting dark. Are your doors shut?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. I want no visitors tonight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm off to bed, {other}. See you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sleep well, {other}. Dream something nice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hear the zombies? Closer than I'd like.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Get inside. Nobody has business being out now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Best stay under a roof in this rain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least the field waters itself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The storm is coming closer, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. Stay away from the tall trees.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How is the harvest looking, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Splendid! Haven't seen ears this full in years.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Prices are up again, so I hear.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An emerald is an emerald. Nothing to be done.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did we even end up here, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask me something easier. Let's get back up.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This heat will be the end of me, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hold on. There must be a portal somewhere.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Cold enough for you, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better ask whether my nose is still attached.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Think the weather will hold?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who knows. The sky does as it pleases.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everything all right with you, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Never better. As long as the bell rings, all is well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm asking five emeralds now. Five!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For one carrot?!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Inflation, {other}. Pure inflation.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you standing against the wall, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm thinking. At least the wall listens.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Welcome to my mansion!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a hut made of three planks, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A mansion with character.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you think the iron one has feelings?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask him, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did. He just stared.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Heh-heh, did you hear? A chicken looked at me!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: ...That is not news, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is to me!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you know the way to the well?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Straight ahead. Like everything around here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ah. Convenient.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The fisherman said his fish was THIS big.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He says that every day, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And every day the fish gets bigger.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is that... player staring at us again?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What player?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That one. The one pretending not to read this.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hrrm.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hmmm.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hmmm-hm.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: ...well said.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Remember old Walter from next door?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The one who turned green?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's him. Doesn't even greet you anymore. Rude.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Chin up, {other}. The world looks different tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you really think so?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Certainly. And if not, I'll be standing next to you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The harvest is in, {other}! All of it, safe!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we celebrate tonight, that much is certain!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've got a strange feeling today, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You have a strange feeling every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And most of the time I'm right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Farmer... I am your father.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's impossible! ...Wait, is that really you, Uncle Bert?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. Forget it. It was a joke.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One emerald to rule them all, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put it away before it corrupts you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm going to make you an offer you can't refuse.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And that would be?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two loaves for one emerald. Fair, no?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: On your feet already, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The wheat doesn't wait.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Morning, {other}. Slept well?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I dreamt of emeralds. Again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Been to the well yet today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Twice. It's always worth it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Done for the day, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Done for the day. Finally.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will you shut the door, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Already did. Twice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you still out here, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Couldn't sleep. Nor could you, apparently.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Something is knocking at my door.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't open it. No matter what you hear.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long is it going to pour like this?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Until it stops, I suppose.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That struck something, I'm certain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's hope it was nothing important.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I say it rains tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I say it doesn't.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One emerald?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One emerald.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do you want for a loaf, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For you? One emerald.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For ME?!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't tell anyone, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The smith sings while he works.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: ...The whole village knows that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The iron one stood outside my door for three hours today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He is keeping watch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He was staring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who actually rings the bell?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought you did.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought you did.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Remember when there were only three houses here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I remember when there was nothing here at all.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There's someone new in the village.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: From where?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: From outside. Where else.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was MY bread, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It was lying on the ground.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was lying there on purpose!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look well today, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I look the same every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And well every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice to have a quiet talk for once.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Need any help, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Always. But not today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If there's trouble: scream.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then the iron one comes. Hopefully.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you sitting in a boat? Here, in the middle of a field?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask whoever put it here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is that a new hat, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is my head.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your door opens inwards.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing. I just think about it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many of us are there in this village?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Enough for one bell, not enough for two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look bad, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're not fine. Come with me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who did that?!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't ask. Just get inside.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you hear the water, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'd rather hear the water than the other thing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What kind of place is this, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't ask. Just keep walking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is this... the end?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It certainly feels like it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Water, {other}. We need water.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We are standing at a well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh. Right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you smell that too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm trying not to.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can't see the sky anymore.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then look up, not ahead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How far does the water go, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Further than we will ever get.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So much wood. We could build.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We could. We just never do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Flowers for your window, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only if you pick them yourself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's snowing pink!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Those are blossoms, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let me have the moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How deep do you sow, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: As deep as the soil allows.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Clang, clang, clang - all day long.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And in the evening your ears ring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you read the book yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Twice. The ending doesn't change.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have your dreams been strange lately too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I don't dream at all. Perhaps that's worse.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How far is it to the next village?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Further than you think. Nearer than you hope.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have a plan!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You have no plan, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: True. But it sounded good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you seen a free workstation anywhere?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. But if I do, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You won't.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There was a light out there, and it moved.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That was a star.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Stars don't move.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That one does.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Red berry or blue berry, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sweet berries are red. Always.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Red it is, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That one just put a bed down for me yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just like that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just like that. I don't understand it either.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Squidward???

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You must be confusing me with someone else.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, you're right, sorry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you see what the blacksmith's charging for armour these days?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Three emeralds. For ONE piece of armour.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I told him that was robbery.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And? What did he say?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He offered me a better one for four.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Typical.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've been thinking about moving to the next village.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So what's keeping you here?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bell. My bed. Honestly, everything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sounds like you're staying, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sounds like it, yeah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What did you catch today, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A boot. Again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At least it was a clean one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Whatever you're making smells good, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It ALWAYS smells good. That's the secret.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ouch. That hurt, didn't it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't ask such a silly question.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sorry about that. Come on, let me help you inside.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sit down, {other}. Now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can still stand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, you can't. Sit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: ...fine. Thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My llamas are absolutely unbearable today, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What's wrong with them?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They're spitting. All of them. Constantly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe they just don't like you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That would hurt, if it weren't so likely.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm telling you, the bell is hanging crooked.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is not.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Look closely.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm looking. It's hanging straight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then maybe it's ME that's crooked.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That would explain a few things.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Very funny.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought it was good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One emerald for three loaves. My final offer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two loaves.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two and a half.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There's no such thing as half a loaf, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fine, two then. Only because I like you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You said that last time too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you ever seen anything round, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Once. A pumpkin. Still somehow blocky, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everything's blocky. Even the pumpkin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That mountain over there is nothing but steps.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's just how mountains are around here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Handy for the knees, at least.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I pulled up all the melons. Every last one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They're back. Overnight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Life finds a way, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wish someone could just beam me out of here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Beam you out? To where?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Anywhere that doesn't have a turnip harvest waiting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can you even sense my power level, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because it's over nine thousand. That's why.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I think you just slept badly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This is my way of trading, {other}, and I'm following it to the end.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's about carrots.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: About MY carrots.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Remember when the village just completely vanished for a moment?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And then it was back. Exactly as it was before.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd rather not ask why.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Whenever I trade, I briefly see everything like through a window.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A window?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Never mind. Do you want the bread or not?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These red rocks are downright blinding.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wait till the midday sun. It gets worse.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've never seen anything grow this fast.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't wait too long, or you'll get stuck in it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These black pillars everywhere - unsettling.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just stay away from the edges.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We could put a bench right here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who sits on a beach without going in the water?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These trunks are so pale, almost like paper.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Careful, or you'll end up writing on one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everything here is red. Even the ground.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better not to ask why.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Barely any light gets through here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: All the better, then no one sees me get lost.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Stay calm, {other}. Not a word too loud.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I've been whispering this whole time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There's something sharp hanging up there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then don't stand right underneath it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So many colours all at once.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I think I'm about to sneeze.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The water's completely frozen over.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better to walk over it than fall in.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Snow among the firs - lovely to look at.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Lovely and cold, more like.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Those spikes look dangerous.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are. Keep your distance.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's dripping from every side down here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least something green grows from it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My boots are completely soaked now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Welcome to the mangroves, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No monsters here at all. Hard to believe.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mushrooms everywhere, though. Also strange.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These trees are massive.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And probably older than the whole village.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The air feels thinner up here, don't you think?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly I find it windy up here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing but grass as far as you can see.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Enough room for a second village, really.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The current's pulling pretty hard.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hold on tight in case you fall in.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Dry out here. And hot.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least there's shade under the acacias.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My feet keep sinking in here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Welcome to the soul sand, {other}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing but stones as far as the eye can see.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least you rarely trip over grass here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It smells of pine sap here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And wet socks. Mine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This blue colour is oddly calming.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It makes me nervous, if anything.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hold on, {other}, the wind means business.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Too late. My hat's already gone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've heard gold sits right under the surface here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then dig. I'll keep an eye on that goat meanwhile.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not a tree in sight around here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Plenty of cacti staring back at you, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you see the panda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That thing sleeps more than you and I combined.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So dense in here, you can barely see your hand in front of your face.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Smells pleasantly green, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not a drop of water as far as you can see.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Plenty of lava, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How on earth do we get back out of here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The same way we came in. Hopefully.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Look, a turtle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That thing's got it better than either of us.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I could sit here for hours.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You already are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why do the trees stand so neatly here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you asking them, or am I?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I like the ground here. Soft.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Until you step on a root.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you smell that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Blossoms. Nothing but blossoms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long do these actually bloom for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Longer than I'd like, honestly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These red mushrooms - are they edible?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't ask me. Ask whoever tries them first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've spotted hoglins around here before.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you'd better stay close to me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why is it so quiet here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe it wants to stay that way. Leave it be.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These giant mushrooms look odd.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better not eat any of them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What was that noise?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I heard nothing. And you heard nothing either.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Those sensors on the walls - are they dangerous?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only if you get loud. So don't.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does anything even survive out here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask the cactus. It's managed for years.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think I spotted a temple back there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then let's not go inside, whatever we do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you hear that dripping?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Constantly. I dream about it by now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Careful, those spikes on the ground are sharp.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks, I just learned that the hard way.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which flower do you like best?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Whichever one stings the least.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bees seem to like you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They don't like anyone. They like blossoms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you hear the birds?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Constantly. Especially first thing in the morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We could gather mushrooms here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only the ones you actually recognise, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't you dare go out on the ice, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm not stupid. ...mostly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your breath practically freezes out here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then maybe say less.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At least it's calm here, no wind.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Cold enough for two winters, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These firs stand so close together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good against the wind. Bad against the cold.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did these grow so tall?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask the frost. I've got no idea.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just stay away from those sharp points.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm careful enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we've been walking in circles.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Third time round. I'm keeping count.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Up there, a temple.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And guaranteed full of traps. Let's be careful.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So much green underground. Strangely beautiful.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Until you step on it and it all bounces.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This cave is almost prettier than outside.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't say that too loud, or someone will move in.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does anyone get through here with dry feet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You don't. Get used to it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These frogs are loud today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe they just don't like you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should we hold a festival out here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With all these butterflies? Why not.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The meadow's especially green today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No wonder, after yesterday's rain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A mooshroom! Did you see that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. It's standing right in front of you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not a single monster here in days.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Enjoy it while it lasts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wonder how deep that goes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Deeper than I'd ever dive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A shipwreck, over there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's hope it's empty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How old do you reckon these trees are?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Older than any story I know.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Enough wood here for a whole village.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And yet I still find it hard to chop one down.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A billy goat, right above us.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep your distance. They like to headbutt.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a lot of snow all at once, way up here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least it melts down there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You can see anyone coming from miles away here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Handy, if you don't like visitors.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So much space, and yet we all still build close together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Habit, {other}. Pure habit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where does the river actually lead?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: To the sea, I'd guess. Like all rivers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The current's strong today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you'd better stay by the bank.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why is everything spaced out so far here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Plenty of room for everyone. Even you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think there's a herd of horses grazing over there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tame one if you like. I'll watch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many layers are you actually wearing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not enough. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: An igloo, over there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's hope nothing unfriendly lives in it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why does everyone keep sinking in here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask the sand. I don't have an answer either.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Those soul particles drifting up - unsettling.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't look too closely and you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Pretty uncomfortable shore to sit on, this one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Plenty of stones to throw, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think there was a shipwreck here once.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Looks that way, yeah.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Over there, a witch's hut.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's give it a wide berth.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you smell that again?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I've stopped asking by now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It smells of fresh wood here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And wet fur. A wolf's been through.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These firs stand close together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good for hiding. Bad for keeping an eye on things.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These blue vines grow like crazy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And I haven't spotted a single enderman. So far.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not a single monster over here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Stay careful anyway. The Nether loves surprises.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hold on to the rock, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am. The wind means business today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These goats leap around here like it's nothing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I don't envy them one bit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Farming? Really?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Someone with talent like yours?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a peaceful life.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Time for a D-D-D-Duel!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What do you want, {other}?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I challenge you. Draw a card!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nah, let's not.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, shame.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Knock, knock.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Creeper - BOOM!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That one was good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Watch out!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Behind you, a three-headed monkey!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Aaahh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just kidding. There are no monkeys here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Phew, good thing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've reinvented the wheel!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What's a wheel?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I just made up the term myself.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ah, right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you hear? The blacksmith hit his thumb again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How many times this week?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Third.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sounds about right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think it's going to rain soon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You say that every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And eventually I'll be right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How was your day, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Long. And yours?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Shorter, thankfully.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you see the new house at the edge of the village?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who's building that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No idea. But the windows are crooked.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think our well is getting old.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It was already old when I moved here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Still holding up bravely, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You know what bothers me?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing really. I just wanted to talk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I tidied up this morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wow, really?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A little. Very little.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds more like you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you know the new one in the village?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not yet. What do they do?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No idea, they just stand by the well all the time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we should eat together more often.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At your place? There's never anything to eat there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Autumn's coming early this year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My bones have noticed too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, we agree on something, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I heard you went travelling.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only as far as the next village.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For you, that's basically a world tour.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do you do when you're not trading?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I think about trading.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think my carrots are growing better this year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You say that every year.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And every year I'm wrong.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you so quiet today, {other}?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Am I?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For five minutes now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh. Guess I'm talking now, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I could've sworn the bell was louder yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe you were just closer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could be.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long have we known each other now, anyway?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Too long to count.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Charming as ever.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have a new neighbour.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And? What are they like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Loud. But friendly loud.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't you think the days are getting shorter?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Every year around this time, yes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Still catches me off guard every time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think I need a new roof.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it leak?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only when it rains.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So, yes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tell me something new, {other}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nothing new. Same as always.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's something too, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Some days just go smoothly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This one isn't one of them, apparently.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How would you know?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just a hunch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think it'll be a good harvest day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't. It just sounds good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If you had one wish, what would it be?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Peace and quiet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: From me?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: From everyone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't sleep at all last night.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was thinking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can't even remember now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You know that feeling when you forget something but not what?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: All the time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good, at least I'm not alone in that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think spring always makes me a little silly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only spring?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: ...fine, maybe not only spring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do you think about a village festival?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who's going to organise it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You, obviously.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I heard the water from the well tastes better now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who says that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I do. Just now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Very convincing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sometimes I think we talk about the weather too much.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What else are we supposed to talk about?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think my garden needs more love.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Or less weeds.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what I meant by love.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you ever been really far from here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Once. As far as the river.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's enough for you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For this life, yes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think today's a day for good news.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have any?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. But I'm hoping for both of us.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do you stand doing the same thing every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I like routines.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So do I, honestly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think this village could use some fresh energy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Or just a new fence.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What was your best trade this week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Three turnips for a smile.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Doesn't sound like a good deal.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It was a good smile, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you also notice how quiet it is today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Too quiet, if you ask me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly what I was thinking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think I should get up earlier more often.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've been saying that for years.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I mean it every single time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you ever thought about moving away?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Every winter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then it's spring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we don't just talk for no reason often enough.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: True. Shall we start now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let's start.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You know what I like about days like this?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How do you mean?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That nothing important happens. Wonderful.
